subject: Hospitality
title: Hospitality Labor Migration
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Hospitality Labor Migration.

hook.text: Dubai's hotels are staffed almost entirely by foreign workers. The Philippines, India.

buildup.text: Filipino hospitality workers are prized worldwide for warmth, English proficiency, and adaptability.

discovery.text: Remittances from hospitality workers abroad represent 10% of the Philippines' GDP.

twist.text: Labor migration creates ethical concerns: low wages, long hours, passport confiscation, and limited rights in some host countries.

climax.text: Hospitality depends on migration but must address exploitation. Ethical labor practices are becoming a brand differentiator.

punchline.text: Global industry, global workforce. Hospitality workers cross borders to serve the world.

quiz.question: Why are Filipino hospitality workers valued globally?
options: Warmth, English proficiency, and adaptability—the Philippines exports more service workers than any nation
